claims.claim: Arendt's concepts of publicity and privacy are connected only loosely and connotatively to outdoor and indoor spaces and their associations with exposure and shelter respectively.

claims.claim: Arendt interpreted Plato's allegory of the cave flatly as a celebratory account of the philosopher's flight from the dark cave of human affairs to the bright sky of ideas.
claims.supporting_excerpt:
Arendt read this allegory , ﬂatly ,
as Plato ’s celebratory account of the philosopher ’s ﬂight from the “dark
cave of human affairs, ” where everything is mere appearance, into the
“bright sky of ideas ” where the “true essence of Being ” can be seen
